name: Seven Stars
identity_check: Confirmed as Seven Stars (sevenstars.vc), the San Francisco seed VC founded by Steven Lee, a former SV Angel partner: the firm site, the 11 Jun 2025 Business Wire release and Fortune agree on name, founder, $40M debut fund and AI focus, and SEC Form Ds for Seven Stars Ventures I and II, L.P. (San Francisco, signed by Steven Lee) match. Press also writes 'Seven Stars Ventures' (Corgi Series B; the Form D fund entity) and 'Seven Stars Capital' (Longeye); accepted because Corgi and Longeye are listed on sevenstars.vc with CEO testimonials naming Seven Stars. Not the Finnish mobile-games studio Seven Stars (Kajaani; seed led by Spintop/Behold Ventures), not Seven Stars Resort & Spa, and not Lee's SV Angel-era deals (ElevenLabs, Mercor, Captions, Reflection AI, Skild AI), which are excluded.

thesis_text.value: Backs AI-native founders at pre-seed and seed, sometimes Series A, across consumer and enterprise software such as healthcare, infrastructure, marketing, vertical AI and applied research. Lee argues AI should lift the wider eight billion people, not just knowledge workers. Co-invests beside other VCs and angels, often as the first check, adding fundraising, hiring and advisor-network help.
